Summary Finding **H2** from the adversarial audit of the MCP brick host (#856, #858). Each server start opens a new `mcp-brick-calls-.ndjson`, and the File sink pruned to its default `MaxRotatedFiles` of 10. An MCP client (VS Code, Claude Code, Cursor) starts the host once per session, so every session older than the last ten had its records deleted, without any warning. Observed over stdio: after 12 starts with one call each, 10 files were left and the first call's `auditId` was no longer on disk. ## Changes - `FileBarrierAuditSinkOptions.MaxRotatedFiles = 0` now means "keep every file". Negative values are still clamped to 1, as before. The doc comment now says that the count includes process restarts. - The host's audit defaults move from `Program.cs` to `AshlarMcpBrickHostDefaults.Audit(localAppData)` in `Ashlar.Mcp.Bricks`. That makes them testable from the net8.0 test project. It also sets `Ashlar:Audit:File:MaxRotatedFiles = 0`. `Program.cs` uses the helper; nothing else about its configuration changes. - Host README: documents `Ashlar__Audit__File__MaxRotatedFiles` and states that the server deletes no audit file. - CHANGELOG entry under `[Unreleased]`. Rebased onto master 46d01ab14 (#868), which already contains the setup-dotnet pins from #876. The only conflict was in the knowledge graph, which I regenerated. ## Testing - On master 46d01ab14, in the devtest container: - `--filter FullyQualifiedName~FileBarrierAuditSink|FullyQualifiedName~McpBrickHostAuditRetention` (net10.0): 27/27. - `Ashlar.Mcp.Server.Tests` (net8.0): 59/59. - New tests: - `McpBrickHostAuditRetentionTests.Under_the_host_defaults_the_first_sessions_record_survives_twelve_server_starts`: 12 compositions under the host defaults, then 12 files with the first `auditId` still present. - `The_host_defaults_name_the_File_sink_flushed_per_event_and_never_pruned`. - `FileBarrierAuditSinkTests.MaxRotatedFilesZero_KeepsEveryFile_AcrossSinkInstances`. - Mutation checks (before the rebase): - `host-default-prunes` (`"0"` replaced by `"10"`): **KILLED** red=failed:2/2 green=passed:2/2. - `sink-zero-clamped` (the zero case removed from `Normalize`): **KILLED** red=failed:1/9 green=passed:9/9. Disk growth: one small JSON line per call, no cap. Operators who want a cap can set the variable. ## ProdStyle [skip-prod-style]: the change under `src/Ashlar.Runtime/Barriers/` is only that `MaxRotatedFiles = 0` now means "keep all". No host sets 0 except the MCP brick host, so the API host's pruning (default 10) is unchanged. Evidence: the `make test-prod-style` selection (`Category=ProdStyle&FullyQualifiedName!~ForgeEndpointsTests&FullyQualifiedName!~FrameworkVirtualProdDemosTests`, net8.0) passes 150/150 on this branch in the devtest container. Touches records/docs: `src/Ashlar.Mcp.Server.Host/README.md` (Audit records, Configuration), `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/knowledge-graph.*`. ## Checklist - [x] Not a versioned release — skip - [x] Documentation updated
